text_block_list.text:
One afternoon. I spotted Sirius Symboli 
talking to Manhattan Cafe.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: A "friend", huh. ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...You actually believe what I'm 
saying...?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I don't give a damn about this "friend" of 
yours, and I sure as hell don't believe in 
it.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Still— it made for a worthwhile coffee 
break.
During recess on a different day.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"This turn is the turning point of the 
match. Do I hold back, or—"

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hold back? Like hell I would. ...Now's the 
time to make my move.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Four Aces right here?! You really went all 
out, didn't you!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: —That's my win.
On yet another day.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Please! Lend me that cue stick! At this 
rate, my happi coat is gonna end up 
half-dried!

I spotted Sirius Symboli socializing all 
over the academy. A few days later, during 
training—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Heh, I've got you—!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Now's the time to make a move!

Even though she was running all by 
herself, she crossed the finish line with 
a ferocious sprint—as if chasing down prey 
ahead of her.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
My visualization of competing against this 
"friend" of hers is still naive, huh... 
Still, it's surprisingly easy to run.

"Friend" was a word used in my 
conversations with Manhattan Cafe.

They also talked about the timing to make 
a move while playing together with their 
friends. ...Could it be—
choice_data_list:
Was that interaction all for the sake of 
this run?

text_block_list.text:
To find out the truth, I asked Sirius 
Symboli—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Ha, naturally. Did you really think I'd be 
interested in playing friends?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
What one gains through interaction becomes 
flesh and blood. That is what I learned in 
high society.

While marveling at her voracious ambition, 
a single question arose in my mind.
choice_data_list: Wait, even from talking to Gold Ship?!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Aah?! How was that an exchange at all?! 
Don't go bringing up stupid memories!

Setting aside my conversation with Gold 
Ship... Thanks to the insights gained from 
interacting with others, her running grew 
even sharper!
